title: Signed exact structure on native closed derived Hom
statement: Let C be a closed braided monoidal Grothendieck abelian category with additive tensor and functorial flat resolutions. On its unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], with the canonical K-flat derived tensor and its right adjoint internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], fix M. The contravariant functor H(K)=RHom(K,M) admits a coherent integer-shift structure which is triangulated. Its degree-n commutation map is (-1)^(n(n+1)/2) times the source-Hom shift adjoint to the total-tensor shift K[-n] tensor L -> (K tensor L)[-n], transported through -(-n)=n. This specifies all integer shifts, not merely the objects or the existence of a third triangle arrow.

proof.text: Represent M by a K-injective I. The evaluation-characterized qhInternalHomToIhom identifies native derived Hom with localization of the ordinary Hom complex. Signed reindexing gives raw shifts; multiply by the quadratic correction. Its cocycle identity cancels tensor interchange signs. This is the native closed-category counterpart of the ringed coefficient calculation.

lean.statement:
theorem nativeDerivedHom_signed_exact
    {C : Type d} [Category.{u + 1} C] [Abelian C]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{u + 1} C] [MonoidalCategory C]
    [MonoidalPreadditive C] [MonoidalClosed C] [BraidedCategory C]
    [Abelian.HasFunctorialFlatResolution C] (M : DerivedCategory C) :
    let H := MonoidalClosed.internalHom.flip.obj M
    ∃ s : H.CommShift ℤ,
      (fun [_s : H.CommShift ℤ] ↦ H.IsTriangulated ∧
        ∀ (K : DerivedCategory C) (n : ℤ),
          (H.commShiftIso n).hom.app (op K) =
            (n * (n + 1) / 2).negOnePow •
              (siteHomOppositeSourceShift K n).hom.app M) (_s := s)

Their names, signatures, docstrings and construction bodies are unchanged; irreducibility attributes bound expansion of the canonical mates.
